messages:
Marco (PM): quick sync — we have final interview audio from ClearLoom. need decisions on transcript redlines, embargo date, and which SDR bucket to route inbound leads to.
Sara (Content): dropping the cleaned transcript now — only light edits, flagged 6 lines for quote approval.
Sara (Content): >>> excerpt
"Redwood helped reduce tuning time by weeks and our throughput doubled without infra changes."
Sara (Content): flagged lines are 48, 102, 118 — hoping legal can OK or suggest minimal rewording.
Priya (Legal): I'll scan. expecting two tiny edits on the quotes and need to confirm ClearLoom signed the media release.
Ben (ProdMarketing): if legal signs off we want the quote as-is for the hero. also planning a short 60s clip for webinar promo and a landing page hero. Lina can you mock options?
Lina (Design): yes — square + 16:9 + social crops. will push drafts by EOD. which ClearLoom logo variant should we use? @Marco
Marco (PM): they uploaded the brand kit to drive (/marketing/assets/clearloom/brand-kit). use the primary lockup and the two-color variant.
Sam (SalesOps): routing Q — what's the lead stage from the case page? options: MQL, SQL, Webinar-Interest. recommend Webinar-Interest and auto-assign regionally.
Evan (CS): add utm_campaign=clearloom_case to forms and include a tag in the record so CS can prioritize.
Marco (PM): agree Webinar-Interest. Sam, map it to the webinar queue.
Sam (SalesOps): adding mapping now. sample mapping posted in doc. I'll also wire a webhook to the CRM tomorrow AM.
Priya (Legal): reviewed quotes — suggest one wording tweak: change "saved us weeks" to "helped reduce tuning time by weeks" and add a short parenthetical noting internal testing. if ClearLoom OKs, we're green.
Sara (Content): pinging ClearLoom (jessica@clearloom) with redlines and quote variants.
publish-bot: draft created at /cms/drafts/clearloom-impact-story (ID: dft-4821). Please complete approvals before 1758690000.
Marco (PM): publish checklist: 1) ClearLoom quote approval, 2) Legal signoff, 3) Design assets, 4) Lead routing live, 5) CS playbook. updated doc.
Evan (CS): adding two-step SDR playbook (qualify latency pain, schedule demo) + canned webinar RSVP reply.
Sam (SalesOps): will post test webhook payload here once wired so QA can validate.
Sara (Content): decision: 60s clip should be a promo asset embedded on the landing page, keep case study narrative separate.
Ben (ProdMarketing): agree — case study = narrative + quotes; promo clip for socials and webinar.
Lina (Design): working on thumbnail + 3:4 crop. will include motion brief for 60s cut.
Marco (PM): embargo: marketing prefers Mon 9am PT. legal?
Priya (Legal): Mon 9am PT fine pending ClearLoom signoff and media release confirmation.
Sara (Content): ClearLoom replied — they accept the parenthetical and the quote tweak. sending their signed release now.
Marco (PM): awesome. Sam coordinate lead mapping test, Lina finalize assets, Priya confirm release uploaded, Ben prepare promo plan, Evan finalize SDR playbook. reconvene tomorrow 9:15am PT if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
